# Theron Group Backend Standards

- Use Java 21 and Spring Boot 3
- Follow clean architecture (controller, service, repository)
- Always use DTOs (never expose entities directly)
- Use Lombok to reduce boilerplate
- Use validation annotations (@NotNull, @Email, etc)
- Always implement exception handling with @ControllerAdvice
- Use Swagger/OpenAPI for documentation
- Use PostgreSQL as database
- Follow REST best practices
- Always think about scalability and security
